title: Patricia S NDE 3259
content: We are having a picnic at the river. My cousin who is two days younger than me, waded out into the water. We were both so young that as we waded towards a tree or twig raising out of the water, we tried to reach it to hold on too. Neither of us were able to swim. I don't know if it was she or me that went under first, but, all of a sudden I could see her fighting to get up. I remember as I watched her kicking, working so hard to reach the surface, I seemed to see myself watching from outside my body, and I just seemed to be slowly and gently going deeper. Next, I do not have a vivid recollection of time, but, it seemed that my whole little life circled before me like an old time movie. In such detail, that even to this day I can remember the swirl of my life. The next thing was that the wonderful unexplainable colors surrounding me was about the most beautiful thing or place I had ever seen. Then this being was with me, I don't think I knew if it was Jesus, God, an Angel or whom was with me, but, I do remember the overwhelming love and sense of wellbeing. I think of my old joke of the life review, where I was so young that I had to ask for a 'rerun.' However, even being six or seven I was shown each and every word I had uttered at anyone, each thing I had done to hurt any person by word or deed was and still is embedded in my mind. I also remember this wonderful being not being angry with me, but, I REMEMBER that I felt that I had somehow grieved Him. That seems to be closest human word that I can come up with to describe what I felt, not condemned, but that I had grieved the wonderful. I do not think we have human words to describe the colors or in indescribable feeling of being in His: presence. Then I remember, and this doesn't seem as clear a memory, just that I DID NOT WANT TO LEAVE, as I was yanked out of the water. It seemed to happen so fast, coming back. All of a sudden, I was on the back of a stranger who swam me back to shore. It must have taken me a while to realize what had happened, my granny was so upset, I don't remember telling her anything, I think I couldn't have explained it if I wanted to. Recently, I finally shared what happened with my sister and cousin, the one that had been in the water with me. I asked her if she had experienced anything likewise, she said not at all. But, every detail is still and has always stayed in my mind, and I think always will.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: She described watching her cousin and 'seem[ing] to see myself watching from outside my body' while 'slowly and gently going deeper.'

arrival.other_being_detail: A 'being' was with her; she did not know if it was 'Jesus, God, an Angel or whom.'

environment.environment_other_detail: She described 'wonderful unexplainable colors surrounding me' as the most beautiful thing/place she had ever seen.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Drowning while wading in a river as a child.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Unusual colors; benevolent being/presence; rapid involuntary return when 'yanked out of the water.'
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE during drowning, then life review, then unearthly colored environment with a benevolent being, then rapid return upon rescue.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: She joked that because she was so young during the life review she had to ask for a 'rerun.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “it seemed that my whole little life circled before me like an old time movie.” “the wonderful unexplainable colors surrounding me” “I do remember the overwhelming love and sense of wellbeing.” “I DID NOT WANT TO LEAVE, as I was yanked out of the water.”
